edicao: Keep the SAME room and the SAME night as the attached panel: the plain warm cream wall, the window with the crescent moon and the dark-blue night sky, the teal curtain, the warm table lamp glowing on the little wooden cabinet, the same SMALL ROUND side table covered in sage-green felt with its wooden rim, the same pink dice, and the same Diana (white cat, black-tipped ear, grey brow marks, the little bandage with dice pips on the bridge of her nose). Same thick cocoa outline, same flat sticker style, same colors and lighting. No text or letters anywhere. Change only the moment: Diana sits behind the round table, gazing calmly at the reader, chin slightly raised. Now ONLY TWO pink dice remain on the felt. The third pink die is at the lower left, in mid-air, falling off the table's edge with two small motion lines, about to leave the frame; she does not look at it. The upper-left third of the frame (top 40%) stays empty plain wall, free for a speech balloon.
